# Inkorbit Creation

> Inkorbit Creation is a creative and digital studio offering branding, design, web development, AI, business automation, content, and marketing services. Based in India and serving clients worldwide.

Inkorbit Creation combines strategy, design, and technology to build distinctive brands and digital experiences. The studio works with businesses across India and internationally.

## Services

- Brand strategy and identity, including logo design, brand guidelines, and campaign creatives.
- Website and digital product design and development, including landing pages, web apps, mobile apps, e-commerce, and UI/UX.
- AI product development, AI-powered applications, retrieval and verification systems, data pipelines, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
- Custom ERP and business process automation, including inventory, orders, scheduling, payments, and role-based dashboards.
- Social media strategy and management, content planning, reels, video production, and SEO blogs.
- Performance marketing, paid campaigns, and conversion tracking.
